result.title: GatedVLA with Camera-Based Emergency Braking: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report
result.summary: This report presents GatedVLA, our entry for the Physical AI AV (PAI-AV) track. Our learned vision-language-action (VLA) policy pairs the driving-pretrained Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B vision-language model with a layer-wise flow-matching action expert that outputs a 2.5 s horizon of acceleration and curvature controls, augmented with a soft visual mask applied to the expert's cross-attention. Compared to an identically trained baseline, the masked policy achieves comparable overall open-loop error while reducing error on left turns. In local closed-loop evaluation across the same 150 scenes (two rollouts per scene), the visual mask increases the mean scene score from 0.479 to 0.517 (paired difference +0.038, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.018, +0.093], wins/losses 37/26, sign test p = 0.21). Incorporating a rule-based automatic emergency braking (AEB) module at deployment further increases the mean score to 0.599 (+0.082, CI [+0.023, +0.143]) and reduces the mean number of scenes with at-fault collisions from 34.0 to 11.0.

AI.brief_summary: 该技术报告提出 GatedVLA：以驾驶预训练的 Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B 为视觉语言主干，接层间 flow-matching 动作专家输出 2.5 秒的加速度与曲率控制，并在专家的 cross-attention 上施加软视觉掩码，在开环误差与 150 场景闭环评分上与该掩码的有无做对照，另在部署时叠加规则式 AEB。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对动作专家 cross-attention 施加软视觉掩码」提供了关于 VLM 内部视觉证据如何被下游读取、以及屏蔽视觉通道对子类行为影响的对照线索，可供核查是否对应 LVR 中的视觉旁路与视觉证据筛选问题；但输出为驾驶控制而非 latent 推理状态，迁移性待评估。
